statBlock.name: Conclave Dryad
statBlock.description: Selesnya dryads advise the Conclave and help design its enclaves. A dryad leading troops may ride an elk-shaped mount made from living branches and vines.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The dryad makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. The dryad can converse with beasts and plants as though they share a language.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the dryad's spell save DC to 17. It needs no material components.
At will. Druidcraft.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Entangle, Plant Growth, Spike Growth.
1/day each. Moonbeam, Grasping Vine, Wall of Thorns.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Vine Staff and Longbow.
Vine Staff. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, vines restrain it for 1 minute. It can use an action to end the effect on itself with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Summon Mount (1/day). Magically bring forth the mount in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. Use the Elk stat block. The mount is a plant with Intelligence 6 and understands Sylvan but cannot speak. It remains for 8 hours, until it or the dryad dies, or until the dryad spends an action to dismiss it. The dryad can speak with it telepathically within 1 mile.
Suppress Magic (Recharge 5–6). Choose one magic item the dryad can see within 120 ft. If it is an artifact, the effect fails. Otherwise its magic shuts off for 10 minutes, until the dryad becomes incapacitated or dies, or until it uses a bonus action to restore the item's magic.

statBlock.name: Deathpact Angel
statBlock.description: An Orzhov angel grants favors to petitioners and collects the debt through service. Some debtors continue serving as indentured spirits after death.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic and radiant. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. Leaving a foe's reach in flight does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. The angel makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the angel's spell save DC to 19 and spell attack bonus to +11. It needs no material components.
At will. Command (as a 2nd-level spell), Detect Evil and Good.
1/day. Raise Dead.
3/day each. Charm Person (as a 5th-level spell), Darkness, Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scythe attacks. Chains of Obligation can replace one Scythe attack.
Scythe. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) necrotic damage.
Chains of Obligation. Choose a creature the angel has charmed that it can see within 90 ft. It must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma save or become paralyzed for 1 minute. Taking any damage ends this paralysis.
sections.Bonus actions: Exploitation of the Debtors. Choose a creature charmed by the angel that it can see within 30 ft. Deal 11 (2d10) necrotic damage to it and gain temporary HP equal to the damage it takes.
sections.Debts Paid: A deathpact angel may offer an indentured spirit release from its debt. If the spirit sees the angel fall to 0 HP, the spirit can destroy itself to bring the angel back to life with 1 HP.

statBlock.name: Devkarin Lich
statBlock.description: A Golgari elf that has prolonged its life through undeath. Fungi help hold its decaying body together.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
Regeneration. The lich recovers 10 HP at the start of its turn. Fire or radiant damage disables the next start-of-turn recovery. The lich dies only when it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Turn Resistance. The lich makes saves against effects that turn undead with advantage.
Undead Fortitude. If damage drops the lich to 0 HP, roll a Constitution save with DC 5 plus the damage taken. Skip this save for radiant damage or damage from a critical hit. On a success, the lich drops to 1 HP.
Undead Nature. The lich needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
The lich is a 14th-level Golgari spellcaster with wizard spells prepared. It uses Intelligence (save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots). Chromatic Orb, Magic Missile, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots). Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spider Climb, Web.
3rd level (3 slots). Animate Dead, Bestow Curse, Fear, Vampiric Touch.
4th level (3 slots). Blight, Evard's Black Tentacles.
5th level (2 slots). Cloudkill, Insect Plague.
6th level (1 slot). Circle of Death, Create Undead.
7th level (1 slot). Finger of Death.
sections.Actions: Noxious Touch. Melee spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 14 (4d6) poison damage. The creature must also succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Legendary actions:
The lich has 3 legendary actions. Spend them on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The lich regains spent actions when its turn begins.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast one of the lich's cantrips.
Noxious Touch (2 actions). Use Noxious Touch.
Disrupt Life (3 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. Success halves the damage.

statBlock.name: Druid of the Old Ways
statBlock.description: A Gruul druid devoted to ancient animal gods and the belief that Ilharg the Raze-Boar will one day trample Ravnica's city into rubble.

sections.Traits:
Siege Monster. The druid deals double damage to objects and structures.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. The druid can converse with beasts and plants as though they share a language.
sections.Spellcasting:
The druid is a 12th-level Gruul spellcaster with druid spells prepared. It uses Wisdom (save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Druidcraft, Produce Flame, Resistance, Thorn Whip.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Faerie Fire, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Beast Sense, Flame Blade, Pass without Trace.
3rd level (3 slots). Conjure Animals, Dispel Magic, Plant Growth.
4th level (3 slots). Dominate Beast, Freedom of Movement, Wall of Fire.
5th level (2 slots). Commune with Nature, Conjure Elemental, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot). Transport via Plants, Wall of Thorns.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage with two hands.

statBlock.name: Felidar
statBlock.description: A silver-patterned celestial cat that forms a close bond with one creature. Azorius officials use these bonds to help locate escaped prisoners.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial and Common but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Bonding. The felidar can form a magical bond with a creature it can see immediately after observing it for at least 1 hour within 30 ft. The bond ends if that creature dies or the felidar bonds with another creature. The partners can speak telepathically within 100 ft. On the same plane the felidar can sense how far away its partner is and in which direction. Either partner can take an action to see and hear through the other's senses until the start of its next turn. While doing so, it loses its own sight and hearing.
Keen Hearing and Sight. The felidar makes Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight with advantage.
Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hitting it with Claws on the same turn, the victim must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone. If the victim is prone, the felidar can make a Claws attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Winged Felidars: A winged felidar uses this block and gains a flying speed of 40 ft.

statBlock.name: Firefist
statBlock.description: A Boros veteran who fights in plate, leads legion troops, and can direct an ally's attack with divine magic.

sections.Spellcasting:
The firefist is a 9th-level Boros spellcaster with cleric spells prepared. It uses Wisdom (save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Light, Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying.
1st level (4 slots). Guiding Bolt, Healing Word, Heroism, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots). Lesser Restoration, Scorching Ray.
3rd level (3 slots). Blinding Smite, Crusader's Mantle, Revivify.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Wall of Fire.
5th level (1 slot). Flame Strike.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Reactions: Guided Attack (recharges after a short or long rest). When the firefist or a creature it can see within 30 ft. makes an attack roll, add +10 to the roll.

statBlock.name: Firemane Angel
statBlock.description: A Boros champion who seeks out the strongest enemy in a fight. Its red hair can ignite into a mane of flame in battle.

sections.Damage resistances: Fire and radiant. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. Leaving a foe's reach in flight does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. The angel makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Relentless (recharges after a short or long rest). When 21 damage or less would drop the angel to 0 HP, the angel drops to 1 HP.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the angel's spell save DC to 18 and spell attack bonus to +10. It needs no material components.
3/day each. Compelled Duel, Guiding Bolt (as a 5th-level spell).
1/day each. Daylight, Fireball (as a 6th-level spell).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 11 (1d10 + 6) with two hands. Add 22 (5d8) fire or radiant damage, chosen by the angel.
